comment: Team-memory vector collections for semantic recall over YOUR OWN context and memory. These hold embeddings of security_memory + engagement_context documents so knowledge-recall finds by meaning. The MCP server populates them; this file is only the FORMAT. 'size' must match the embedding model the server uses (default 1536 = OpenAI text-embedding-3-small); override with ASTERGUARD_EMBED_DIM. The proprietary knowledge catalog (ATT&CK/CAPEC/CWE/control crosswalk) is NOT defined here — it is vendor-maintained and never shipped.

collections.name: security_memory
collections.purpose: semantic recall over team security memory (decision/finding/fix/review/waiver docs)

collections.name: engagement_context
collections.purpose: semantic recall over folded engagement-context summaries (resume the nearest prior context by meaning)
